ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a table of average land prices at different distances from the city center in Kunming City from 2001 to 2005; the columns are distance from the city center 1km, 2km, 4km, and 8km, and the rows include commercial land, comprehensive/office land, residential land, and industrial land. From the table, it is read that: commercial land is respectively 4600, 3400, 2200, and 300 yuan/m²; comprehensive/office land is respectively 3600, 2600, 1800, and 600 yuan/m²; residential land is respectively 2800, 2100, 1400, and 600 yuan/m²; industrial land is respectively 900, 800, 700, and 400 yuan/m². Then reason: the question asks to judge which type of land has the largest land price attenuation gradient as the distance from the city center increases. Comparing according to the first-and-last land price decrease from 1km to 8km: commercial land decreases by 4600-300=4300 yuan/m²; comprehensive/office land decreases by 3600-600=3000 yuan/m²; residential land decreases by 2800-600=2200 yuan/m²; industrial land decreases by 900-400=500 yuan/m². The distance spanned by each type is the same, and the largest decrease is for commercial land, so its average attenuation gradient is the largest.
